setup_subtitle: Pre-configure your server and Wi-Fi credentials into flash memory during installation.
step1_d: Use a USB-C data cable (not charge-only) to connect the reader to your computer.
step2_d: Select the device port in the browser popup. The page will identify your chip (ESP32-C3 or ESP32-S3).
step3_d: Compatible models are highlighted. If the model was not identified automatically (e.g. X4 vs X3), click yours.
step4_d: Wait for flashing to complete (30–60 seconds). Once done, the reader restarts into Book Orbit!
faq1_q: No serial port appears in the browser popup?
faq1_a: Make sure you are using a USB data cable. Try flipping the USB-C plug. If the device was asleep, press the power button to wake it up, or hold Power + Back/Reset to reboot into download mode.
faq2_q: Device has locked bootloader from factory (Xteink)?
faq2_a: Certain Xteink units ship with USB flashing locked in factory firmware. If flashing fails to start, run the community OTA Unlocker tool once to unlock USB flashing.
faq3_q: Will my books and SD card files be deleted?
faq3_a: No. Flashing only writes to the internal ESP32 flash chip. Your MicroSD card with books and settings remains untouched unless you explicitly enable the SD card wipe option.

fonts_section_desc: Book Orbit supports TrueType (.ttf) and OpenType (.otf) vector fonts. You can write them directly to your SD card from the browser or download an archive.
fonts_sd_badge_supported: ✓ Direct MicroSD writing supported by browser
fonts_sd_badge_unsupported: ℹ Direct SD writing is unavailable in this browser
fonts_sd_unavailable_hint: Direct SD writing requires browser access to folders. Open the flasher over HTTPS or localhost. You can also download the archive and extract it to your SD card.
fonts_sd_brave_hint: In Brave, set File System Access API to Enabled at the address below and relaunch the browser. Then reopen the flasher over HTTPS or localhost. If the setting is unavailable, download the archive and extract it to your SD card.
fonts_sd_brave_link_hint: If the link does not open, copy the address and paste it into the Brave address bar.
fonts_btn_install_sd: Write Selected Fonts to SD Card
fonts_zip_hint: Upload the archive directly through web config. For a card reader or USB mass storage, extract it to the card root to create the /fonts/ folder.
fonts_install_done: 🎉 Selected fonts were successfully written to the SD card under /fonts/!

fonts_embedded_label: Embed font into internal Flash memory (SPIFFS)
fonts_embedded_none: Do not embed (read fonts from MicroSD)
fonts_embedded_hint: The font will be written into the reader's internal SPIFFS partition (~3.4 MB) and remain available without an SD card.
fonts_check_connect: Connect the device over USB to check the font in internal Flash.
fonts_flash_empty: No valid installed font in Flash.
fonts_flash_unavailable: No Flash font partition is available.
fonts_flash_unknown: Could not check the Flash font. Reconnect the device to check again.
fonts_card_check_hint: To check MicroSD, connect the card to your computer and select its root folder. The reader USB bootloader cannot access MicroSD contents.
fonts_card_empty: No TTF/OTF files in the selected card’s /fonts/ folder.
fonts_device_no_msc_hint: %DEVICE% does not support USB mass storage, so the flasher cannot write fonts to its MicroSD over USB. Download fonts.zip and upload the archive through the device web config. You can also use a card reader. Embedding a font in internal Flash during firmware installation is supported.
fonts_device_msc_hint: %DEVICE% supports USB mass storage. Enable that mode on the device, then select the card root folder to write fonts. You can also upload through web config.
fonts_web_config_steps: Download fonts.zip using the button above. Open web config in the device settings, connect to its Wi-Fi network or the same local network, and visit the address on the device screen. In the Fonts tab, select fonts.zip and click Upload. No manual extraction is needed. Then choose a family in Settings → Book appearance and save. Updated firmware with ZIP support is required.
fonts_using_card_reader: The card is connected to the computer through a card reader
fonts_sd_badge_web_config: ℹ Upload to MicroSD through web config or a card reader
fonts_flash_hint: Store up to 32 additional families within the Flash partition. New families are added without replacing others. A contiguous free block is required; remove unused families if space is insufficient.
fonts_flash_capacity_unknown: Connect a device running Book Orbit over USB to detect partition capacity.
fonts_flash_too_big: Insufficient contiguous Flash space. Remove unused families or use MicroSD.
fonts_flash_done: Font installed in Flash. Select this family in the reader appearance settings.
fonts_flash_unchanged: This font is already in Flash. The files match; no rewrite is needed.
fonts_firmware_builtin: Built into firmware: %NAME% (does not occupy the separate font partition).
fonts_builtin_variant: Built into firmware — installation and removal are unavailable
fonts_card_flash_blocked: Already in Flash. Remove the family from Flash before uploading it to the card.
fonts_builtin_card_blocked: Built into firmware: card upload is blocked. A built-in font cannot be removed separately.
fonts_flash_deleted: Selected family removed from Flash. Other families are unchanged.
connection_inspection_warning: USB is connected, but Flash inspection did not complete. Font status is unknown; writing and removing fonts require a successful inspection. See the console for details.
fonts_flash_usage: Partition: %TOTAL% KB · used: %USED% KB · free: %FREE% KB.
fonts_flash_update_required: Update the device firmware: the installed version does not support a multi-family font catalog yet.
